hook.text: Your kitchen has a root that fights nausea, soothes sore muscles, and warms you from the inside.

tips.text: Ginger tea may help calm an upset stomach and reduce motion sickness. Simmer three thin slices in hot water for ten minutes, then sip slowly.
It contains gingerol, a natural compound that supports the body's anti-inflammatory response. Add grated ginger to stir-fries, soups, or salad dressings.
For sore throats or coughs, mix fresh ginger juice with raw honey and a squeeze of lemon. Take a teaspoon two or three times a day.

cta.text: Save this for the next time you feel under the weather.
